# Authored Alder fixture

Original expressive guide for preserving composition while adding portable brand capabilities. Artwork derives from wstack’s own sprout, sunrise and cairn SVG fixtures; no customer brand is reproduced. The local Geist font retains its OFL notice. `index.html`, `theme.css`, `site.js`, source artwork and metadata are authored inputs. The browser proof adds an optional capability section only inside a disposable copy.
